Product Analytics (eSIM vs Plastic, Validity)

Per strict data integrity requirements, no synthetic mock data is rendered. The target table public.products is defined in the database schema. Once schema usage permissions are configured, direct aggregation queries will populate top products by sales, revenue, SIM type split, and validity buckets.

Target Source: public.products & public.orders

Destination Analytics (Country Distribution)

Per strict data integrity requirements, no synthetic mock data is rendered. The target table public.destinations is defined in the database schema. Once schema usage permissions are configured, country-level order counts will render as horizontal bar charts.

Target Source: public.destinations & public.orders
